items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex at day's high, rises 500 points, Nifty reclaims 22,700
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Tuesday:  In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap rose 0.58 per cent and 0.91 per cent, respectively

items.title: Tilaknagar Inds: HDFC Sec keeps 'buy', bets on Imperial Blue's growth story
items.description: According to HDFC Securities, ground checks indicate that Tilaknagar Industries is effectively addressing state-specific requirements to strengthen the Imperial Blue franchise.

items.title: In sweet spot! Sugar stocks surge up to 9%. What's behind the rise?
items.description: Analysts attribute the current rally in sugar stocks to the latest surge in global sugar prices. US sugar futures rose 4 per cent in a day, 14 per cent in a month, and over 23 per cent in a year.

items.title: Honasa Consumer soars 10% on strong Q2 biz update; stock nears 52-week high
items.description: On profitability, Honasa said it continues to deliver on its goal of EBITDA margin improvement, and management expects the business to deliver an early double-digit operating margin profile in Q2.

items.title: Sterlite Tech gains 5% as Nomura initiates coverage with 'Buy' call
items.description: Nomura initiated coverage on the optical fibre cable maker with a 'Buy' rating and a target price of ₹1,350.

items.title: Large-caps regain favour as oil, bond yields fuel rate-hike worries
items.description: The US 10-year Treasury yield has climbed to 5.32 per cent from 4.15 per cent at the end of 2025, a rise of 117 basis points (bps) so far in 2026. Brent crude oil, meanwhile, is testing $100/bbl mark.

items.title: Vedanta to announce 1st dividend after demerger this week; stock up 4%
items.description: Vedanta will announce its first interim dividend after the demerger on October 8. Vedanta has set Octobr 14 as the diidend record date.

items.title: Private bank stocks rally up to 4% day ahead of RBI MPC Oct meet outcome
items.description: The Nifty Private Bank index advanced over 1%, while the Bank Nifty and Nifty PSU Bank index rose 0.6% and 0.3% respectively on Tuesday, a day ahead of the RBI policy decision.

items.title: BHEL share price rallies 5%, hits new high; what's driving PSU stock?
items.description: In the past six months, the stock price of BHEL outperformed the market by surging 82% as compared to a 2% decline in the BSE Sensex.

items.title: Capital markets related stocks in demand: BSE, MOFSL, Groww jump up to 3%
items.description: Shares of capital market-related stocks were in demand on Tuesday amid reports that SEBI is likely to exclude derivatives from the Closing Auction Session (CAS) for at least a year.

items.title: Shah Investor's Home lists at mere 2% premium despite 38x bids for IPO
items.description: Shah Investor's Home IPO listing: Ahead of the listing, the grey market premium (GMP) for Shah Investor's Home was 10.18 per cent, with the debut seen at a price of ₹184.

items.title: Q1 results impact: Rentomojo shares jump 6% on first earnings post-listing
items.description: Rentomojo shares made a strong debut on the bourses last month. Its shares were listed at ₹482 on the NSE, up 19.42 per cent from the issue price of ₹404.

items.title: SRIT India shares make positive debut, list at nearly 14% premium
items.description: SRIT India shares listed 13.85 per cent higher at ₹148 on NSE and 7.54 per cent higher at ₹139.80 on NSE.

items.title: Trent rallies 10% after Q2 business update, m-cap tops ₹1.5 trillion
items.description: Trent's stock opened at ₹2,800 on the BSE and soon hit the 10 per cent upper price band of ₹2,832.50, which pushed its market capitalisation past the ₹1.5 trillion mark.

items.title: IEX Q2 electricity traded volume rises 12.7% as power demand stays strong
items.description: IEX traded 39.7 billion units of electricity in Q2 FY27, up 12.7% year-on-year, while day-ahead and real-time market clearing prices rose sharply

items.title: GEC-III boosts outlook for T&D sector; GE Vernova among top bets: MOFSL
items.description: GEC-III strengthens the visibility of India's long-duration transmission and storage investment cycle, Motilal Oswal Wealth noted.

items.title: TCS Q2 preview, dividend: Analysts see modest growth; PAT may rise by 13%
items.description: TCS Q2 results date, dividend announcement: TCS will declare its Q2 results on Oct 8. Besides, TCS could also recommend an interim dividend. TCS has set Oct 14 as the dividend record date

items.title: Asian shares track Wall Street higher, Treasury yields near decades high
items.description: The euro languished ​near 17-month lows after briefly touching $1.116 overnight, pressured by mounting fiscal concerns in France

items.title: Stocks to watch: Trent, Vedanta, Axis Bank, Adani Power, Marico & more
items.description: Stocks to watch today: Vedanta's board is proposed to meet on Thursday, October 08 to consider and approve the first interim dividend on equity shares, if any, for the Financial Year 2026-27.

items.title: Stock ideas for today: Kotak Sec is bullish on HAL & one more stock
items.description: Kotak Securities recommends 'Add' on Hindustan Aeronautics and 'Buy' on Honasa Consumer, citing strong order visibility and margin expansion for both the companies.
